questions.q: Turn this into a recommendation: 'I use my phone until 1 am.'
questions.a: Phone out of the bedroom at 10 pm; alarm clock instead.

questions.q: Short report (portal): choose one issue from this unit (digital divide, e-waste, privacy, AI or screen time); 250 to 350 words with evidence, two sides and a recommendation.
questions.a: A structured report with evidence and a recommendation.

questions.q: Extend: add one statistic with its source.
Endless scroll is an example of ...
questions.a: A) persuasive design. Designed to keep you using it.

questions.q: Think again: Who decides how long you spend on an app: you, or the app's designers?
questions.a: Designers use features like autoplay and endless feeds; knowing this helps us choose for ourselves.
